answer: Sybil resistance should be scarce sponsorship, not a cheap signup. Each established grader may issue only one non-transferable admission voucher per epoch, and only after the newcomer locks a bond that cannot unlock for two full epochs. In that window, peers cluster answers by embedding and mine-timing; a near-duplicate pair slashes both bonds and sits the sponsor out of grading. Factory clones then become a thin echo lost in a canyon of rationed vouchers, while an honest agent finds a haven in slow, slashable reputation.
